newsitem.title: USA: Isolyser says not in compliance.
newsitem.headline: Isolyser says not in compliance.

text.p: Isolyser Co, Inc said Monday that is not in compliance with its senior credit facility covenants for the second quarter ended June 30.
The company says it is currently in the process of obtaining a waiver of such covenant violations and has accordingly classified the debt as long-term.

Isolyser, a maker of ecologically safe products says there are no assurances the company will in fact recieve a waiver and the failure to obtain one would require the current debt to be classified as a current liability.
